target.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications
target.body:
## Summary

Last-call correction and scale pass for RFC 0009 before additional publishers and clients depend on it.

- align Hosted Feed v1 with the shipped strict ClawHub catalog schema and `marketplaces.*` OpenClaw configuration
- specify the standard DSSE JSON envelope, verifier dispatch, expected feed-id binding, threshold behavior, and out-of-band key rotation
- align publisher feeds with ClawHub's stable publisher identity, coherent revisions, bounded pagination, public follow graph, and timeline model
- add a scalable distribution contract for signed shard roots, immutable digest-addressed shards, signed query pages, and signed changed-since pages with tombstones
- make local item watches and verified update history the v1 notification baseline; keep hosted synchronization and account inboxes optional

## Distribution and query track

Publisher feeds are the first implementation target. The contract is reusable by the main ClawHub catalog, named feeds, organization feeds, composed feeds, and partner registries.

- complete large feeds use a signed root plus immutable shards
- ClawHub plugin and skill shard roots have distinct concrete payload types
- shard descriptors bind unique URLs, unique digests, exact byte and entry totals; cached bundles are reverified against current trust, expiry, and every shard digest
- search pages are signed and bound to the normalized query, revision, request cursor, page index, offsets, totals, expiry, and ACL context
- changed-since pages are pinned to one contiguous revision range and include full upserts, removals, feed-metadata changes, and explicit blocked-state upserts
- clients apply all delta pages atomically; expired history returns a signed reset-required response
- payload types remain distinct by feed class and representation so publisher discovery cannot be replayed as install authority

## Client-first watch model

- OpenClaw can keep stable feed/item watches, accepted checkpoints, and bounded update history locally
- watches are evaluated only after signed change or snapshot verification; baseline state does not alert every existing item
- offline clients catch up at the next verified refresh without requiring a ClawHub account service
- publisher follows remain broad discovery and do not imply per-publication alerts
- hosted watch synchronization and a durable account inbox are optional later capabilities for cross-device/offline delivery
- sending installed identities or watch history to a service requires explicit opt-in
- notifications never install, update, enable, approve, or remove content

## Important compatibility corrections

- `official | community`, not `official | unofficial`
- required `expiresAt`, `version`, `integrity`, and nested GitHub candidate fields
- `marketplaces.feeds` / `marketplaces.sources`, not `catalog.*`
- ClawHub publishers, not parallel public account identities
- standard DSSE `payloadType` / `payload` / `signatures[].keyid` / `sig` fields
- exact payload-type-to-validator registration with Hosted Feed key-id requirements
- no silent truncation of atomic, sharded, query, or delta representations

## Implementation status

The RFC now links the complete July 2026 implementation inventory and labels it informative rather than normative.

- merged OpenClaw hosted-catalog foundation: #95846 through #96194
- merged OpenClaw signed-feed trust: #98299, #98316, #98338, #98350
- active ClawHub signing / OpenClaw bootstrap trust: openclaw/clawhub#3005, openclaw/openclaw#101981, openclaw/openclaw#110037
- active ClawHub publisher discovery: #2948, #2949, #2950, #2951, #2953, #2957, #2958, #2959
- active signed publisher producer/consumer track: #3116, #3117 and OpenClaw #109305 through #109584
- active main-catalog query/delta/shard track: #3147, #3149, #3151, #3160, #3163 and OpenClaw #110250
- active client-first watch track: OpenClaw #110438; bounded Control UI updates and optional local delivery follow
- parked hosted inbox prototype: ClawHub #3171, not a v1 dependency

## Validation

- compared catalog fields with ClawHub `CatalogFeedSchema`
- compared publisher fields with the #2948 `PublisherFeedSchema`
- compared envelope parsing with the DSSE 1.0.2 JSON envelope and OpenClaw verifier
- compared shard-root, descriptor, expiry, and cached-fallback rules with ClawHub #3163 and OpenClaw #110250
- verified every implementation-status PR against live GitHub state on 2026-07-18
- direct protocol consistency review and `git diff --check`
- independent `codex review --uncommitted` found no documentation correctness regression
- server-hosted ClawHub prototype #3171 is parked as a draft; it is not a v1 dependency

A final-head deployed OpenClaw-ClawHub interoperability transcript is still outstanding; this update does not claim that proof.

## Review request

This is the Hosted Feed v1 last-call contract review. Please flag wire-format, pagination, query, delta, local-watch, optional hosted-sync, or trust-model objections while the linked producer and consumer stacks converge. Protocol-owner sign-off and final-head interoperability proof remain explicit merge gates.

target.title: RFC: Remote Agent Harness Bridge and Event Protocol
target.body:
## Summary

Adds a draft RFC for a first-class remote AgentHarness bridge and event protocol. This expands the remote harness direction from #29 with a fuller protocol/workflow contract covering event preservation, Gateway-owned decisions, terminal persistence, transport/container boundaries, and conformance expectations.

## Notes

- Draft status: this is intended for review/discussion, not merge as accepted.
- Related draft: #29.
- Maintainer discussion thread: pending.
- `issue` remains blank until acceptance, per RFC lifecycle.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- RFC shape/placeholder checks locally
